import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModules
import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional

/-!
# Inclusions between divisor modules

For `D ≤ E`, the inclusion of rational sections `𝒪(D) ⊆ 𝒪(E)` is compatible
with the regular-function action, hence gives a morphism of `O_X`-modules.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The zero-divisor comparison recovers a regular function with the same generic germ. -/
theorem germ_divisorModulesZeroIso_hom {U : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K (0 : X.CurveDivisor), U)) :
    (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom
      ((divisorModulesZeroIso K).hom.app U s) = divisorVal K s := by
  rw [← divisorVal_divisorModulesZeroIso_inv K hU]
  rw [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Modules.Hom.comp_app, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Modules.Hom.id_app, AddCommGrpCat.id_apply]

private lemma divisorSections_inclusion_qsmul {D E : X.CurveDivisor}
    (h : D ≤ E) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U))
    (s : divisorSections K D U) :
    (Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U)
      (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r s)) =
      QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K E) le_rfl r
        (Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U) s) := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
  · have heq :
        Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U)
            (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r s) =
          QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K E) le_rfl r
            (Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U) s) := by
      apply divisorSection_ext K
      have hinc (x : divisorSections K D U) :
          divisorVal K (Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U) x) =
            divisorVal K x := rfl
      rw [hinc, divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
        divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU), hinc]
    exact heq
  · haveI := divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K (D := E) hU
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- The canonical inclusion `𝒪(D) → 𝒪(E)` for `D ≤ E`. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesLE {D E : X.CurveDivisor} (h : D ≤ E) :
    divisorModules K D ⟶ divisorModules K E where
  val := PresheafOfModules.homMk
    { app := fun U => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U.unop)).toAddMonoidHom
      naturality := by
        intro U V i
        exact congrArg (fun f => (forget₂ (ModuleCat K) AddCommGrpCat).map f)
          ((divisorPresheafLE K h).naturality i) }
    (fun U r s => divisorSections_inclusion_qsmul K h U.unop r s)

@[simp]
lemma divisorModulesLE_app_apply {D E : X.CurveDivisor} (h : D ≤ E)
    (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) :
    (divisorModulesLE K h).app U s =
      Submodule.inclusion (divisorSections_mono K h U) s := rfl

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
instance divisorModulesLE_mono {D E : X.CurveDivisor} (h : D ≤ E) :
    Mono (divisorModulesLE K h) := by
  apply Modules.mono_of_injective_app
  intro U s t hst
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg
    (fun q : divisorSections K E U => (q : X.functionField)) hst)

/-- The inclusion keeps the represented rational value. -/
lemma divisorVal_divisorModulesLE {D E : X.CurveDivisor} (h : D ≤ E)
    {U : X.Opens}
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) :
    divisorVal K ((divisorModulesLE K h).app U s) = divisorVal K s := by
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
